plugins.name: channel-telegram
plugins.description: Telegram bot webhook: each chat is a Sinty session; the agent's answer is sent back with sendMessage

plugins.name: channel-voice
plugins.description: Voice turn: text in, agent text out. Speech-to-text and text-to-speech stay outside this plugin.

plugins.name: channel-webhook
plugins.description: Sync chat webhook: one POST runs a turn and returns the agent's text. Same role as the n8n chat webhook.

plugins.name: context-inspector
plugins.description: Chat view (Контекст, next to Чат/Журнал) that shows what went into the prompt on every model step of the open chat: system prompt, skills, memory, recall, hooks, plugin contexts, tokens

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Run one task in Claude Code, Codex or Grok CLI and return only the final text

plugins.name: diffusion
plugins.description: A video editor inside each harness project. Films belong to that project. Agents cut, preview and export. Speech, sound questions and generated pictures live in other plugins.

plugins.name: fact-extractor
plugins.description: Memory processor: extracts durable facts after each turn with the cheap model route and filters memory writes

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Forwards agent.state to a Herdr-compatible URL so an external board can show idle, working and blocked

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: Write a HyperFrames HTML composition and render it to MP4. The tab shows when heygen-com/hyperframes has a newer release.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: Kanban board for a project: assignee, reviewer, dependencies, and notes in the team chat

plugins.name: mcp-catalog
plugins.description: Settings → MCP: installed list, curated catalog cards, and custom add via POST /v1/plugins/mcp

plugins.name: memory-obsidian
plugins.description: Read-only memory provider: searches an Obsidian (Markdown) vault with its own index in $DATA

plugins.name: otel
plugins.description: Writes turn, model and tool events as JSON lines for later OpenTelemetry export

plugins.name: provider-anthropic
plugins.description: Anthropic Messages protocol for Claude models

plugins.name: provider-openai-compat
plugins.description: Chat Completions protocol: xAI Grok, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM and other compatible APIs

plugins.name: provider-openai-responses
plugins.description: OpenAI Responses API protocol: GPT-5 and o-series models with reasoning summaries

plugins.name: responsive-turn
plugins.description: Prompt rule: acknowledge the user immediately, run long work as background agent.task, report on task.completed

plugins.name: runninghub
plugins.description: RunningHub standard models: search the public registry, then upload, submit and poll. Text models stay on the Models settings card.

plugins.name: runtimes
plugins.description: Install FFmpeg, Python and ImageMagick for the agent, and point Chrome at the Chromium Playwright already downloaded.

plugins.name: scheduler
plugins.description: Durable cron and fire-at jobs that wake a session while Sinty is running

plugins.name: server-a2a
plugins.description: A2A agent card and message/send: another agent can give Sinty a task and read the answer

plugins.name: server-agui
plugins.description: AG-UI endpoint: stream the agent's runs to AG-UI clients such as CopilotKit

plugins.name: server-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server (Streamable HTTP): Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients can give the agent tasks and read its sessions

plugins.name: server-openai-api
plugins.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint: any OpenAI client can talk to the agent as if it were a model

plugins.name: site
plugins.description: The site: pages, posts, categories and templates in the harness. The public site reads published records from here.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Skills: the skills catalog in the prompt and skill.read, skill.files, skill.read_file, skill.write_file, skill.edit, skill.write

plugins.name: syntet
plugins.description: Typed calls to a Syntet site: who am I, list generations, record token usage

plugins.name: tool-fs
plugins.description: Read, list, write and edit files in the workspace and skills folders

plugins.name: tool-listen
plugins.description: Ask a question about a sound file: audio.listen extracts the audio with ffmpeg and sends it to a model that accepts audio

plugins.name: tool-stt
plugins.description: Transcribe audio files in the workspace: stt.transcribe returns the spoken text with word times and speaker labels when the model sends them

plugins.name: tool-vision
plugins.description: Look at image files in the workspace: vision.look sends pixels to a vision model and returns text (describe / OCR / find)

plugins.name: tool-web
plugins.description: Web tools: web.search, web.read, web.links, web.screenshot, web.interact, web.fetch_file. Public internet only; the core checks every address

plugins.name: ui-web
plugins.description: Web UI: chat, sessions, approvals, journal, supervisor and kanban. Built from apps/web

plugins.name: usage
plugins.description: Settings → Расход: requests, tokens and charts from the session journal (usage.recorded)
